author: mmarriot
body:
#### PR description: 
 
 The trackster tables of the HGCAL and NGT scouting NanoAOD write the axis components the wrong way round: `eVector0_y` holds `eigenvectors()[0].z`, and `eVector0_z` holds `eigenvectors()[0].y`. This PR swaps them back
in all five places:

- `DPGAnalysis/HGCalNanoAOD/python/hgcalTracksters_cfi.py`
- `HLTrigger/NGTScouting/python/hltTracksters_cfi.py`
- `HLTrigger/NGTScouting/python/hltSimTracksters_cfi.py`

Only the `eVector0_y` and `eVector0_z` branches change.

#### PR validation:

On ttbar 0PU, for CLUEstering tracksters above 5 GeV (641 tracksters), the median |cos| between the axis and the barycenter direction goes from 0.21 to 0.999.
title: Fix the swapped y and z components of the trackster principal axis in the HGCAL and NGT scouting NanoAOD
